description:
Network monitor for Windows - see exactly which app uses your internet, capture packets explained in plain English, and block any app with a one-click firewall.

NetPulse shows exactly which program is using your internet, how much, and where it goes — from Windows' own kernel network events, so the numbers per app are exact. Keep history as long as you like, block any app in one click, check your network for hijacking and open doors, and capture packets with a plain-English explanation of each one. Everything is measured and stored on your PC: no account, no cloud, no telemetry.

Free for personal use; business or commercial use requires a paid license.

- Same font and text sizes as the other TAPATCH apps
- New UI size in Settings → Size and window: text, buttons and panels get bigger or smaller together (60–200%). Ctrl + and Ctrl − work too, Ctrl 0 goes back to 100%
- The window opens where you left it, on the same screen and at the same size. Or pick Full screen under When the window opens
license_or_tos: Free for personal use; commercial use requires a paid license
